verdict.rationale: TaxJar's own API, authenticated by API key, exposes a nexus-regions listing and lets you push order transactions, so an agent could read part of the tax posture and act on transaction data. Registrations, accrued liability and upcoming filings are documented only as dashboard and AutoFile features, not as API reads. There is no MCP surface, and the evidence shows only a single API key with no scoping. missing for 10: API access to registrations, accrued liability and upcoming-filing data, scoped or least-privilege credentials, an MCP server, machine-readable agent docs (llms.txt and OpenAPI both 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my tax posture — nexus status, registrations, accrued liability, upcoming filings — and act on it through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: TaxJar uses API keys to allow access to the API.
You can use our API to get information on sales tax rates, categories or upload transactions.
